claim: Opens a safe sample page in one click
sandbox: fresh browser context; click Try it with sample data; assert demo banner and sample actions

claim: Demo — sample data, nothing is saved
sandbox: fresh browser context; intercept all requests during demo command; assert same-origin only and demo storage key

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context; visit demo, wait for service worker, set context offline, reload demo

claim: The extension scans only the active page after you open it
sandbox: production extension package; assert activeTab permission and no declarative content script or all-site host permission

claim: Spoken commands run only when on-device speech processing is available
sandbox: production extension package; assert processLocally is required and its typed fallback is present

claim: Delete and other sensitive labels are marked for review
sandbox: browser page with concatenated inline action text; collect actions and assert Delete saved draft is destructive

claim: Undo restores a locally removed page item when the page allows it
sandbox: browser page where Delete saved draft removes its containing list item; activate then undo and assert the complete item returns

claim: The extension lists visible labelled controls on the active page
sandbox: browser page with one visible labelled button and one hidden button; collect actions and assert only the visible label appears

where: landing limits, README, Privacy, extension footer
sandbox: browser page with a password field and a normal button; collect actions and assert Password is absent

claim: Speech starts only while you hold the speak control
sandbox: production extension popup bundle; assert pointer down starts and pointer up stops listening, with no periodic recording loop

claim: A $12 one-time Pro license adds local command aliases
sandbox: landing page plus live checkout; assert first-screen $12 fact, restore-license control, HTTP 200 Dodo page, approved product ID, name, and $12.00 total

claim: Core page actions and safety checks stay free
sandbox: fresh demo browser storage; run Save address and assert it works with no saved license token

claim: Page labels stay in your browser
sandbox: inspect the injected page agent used for collection and activation; assert it contains no network API
